name: Campaign
publication_holds: Live source and version verification hold: no source URL, version or date was resolved during this no-tools audit. SRC-006 cites ISO 21502 through a committee page for normative text that is paywalled and not readable at that URL; SRC-007 carries an access date but no version; SRC-008, SRC-010, SRC-011 and SRC-012 pin 2026 publication or API versions; SRC-013 pins RFC 3339 as updated by a later RFC. Every pin must be re-fetched, re-dated and re-pinned before promotion, and any unresolvable URL must drop the findings that depend on it to unsupported.

Absence-of-independent-review hold, owner-authorized: the repository owner waived Claude on 2026-09-06 after 1800, 900, 600 and 300 second attempts produced no result, and waived Grok as unavailable, slow or schema-invalid. Codex is therefore the sole active provider, and this no-tools adversarial pass audits that same stream from local evidence only. It is not, and must never be described as, independent external second-provider review. The waiver, its authorization, and this limitation must appear in every publication artifact.

Relationship contract hold: frozen_context is empty and no approved relation rows were supplied, so the registry parent link to Project and the proposed party, activity, content, channel, budget, contract, event, observation, policy and audit links remain unadjudicated. Publish with no asserted relations and with the parent link shown as a pending hold rather than an implied edge.

Question and artifact template hold: q02 and q03 are template-identical across all 24 findings and every artifact reuses one media_or_form pair and one name-substituted identity strategy that mistakenly constrains campaign identity rather than artifact identity. The interrogative and artifact layers must be rewritten per finding, and the {artifact-kind} token plus delimiter escaping must be defined, before canonical promotion.

Protected-data and operational-guidance hold: access scopes are drawn from the record plane (bundle, layer, finding, artifact) rather than the subject graph, suppression and opt-out retention beyond campaign disposition is unspecified, and consent ownership is only implicitly external. Do not publish or operationalize targeting, suppression, consent or cross-channel linkage guidance from this draft, and do not treat its access rules as enforceable authorization.

Coverage and status hold: the provider checklist marks all sixteen dimensions covered while the model itself declares that no independent result was obtained and that sector profiles are missing. Publish as reviewable draft with the checklist downgraded to partial, pending cross-sector, political, public-health, marketing, fundraising, advocacy, security, privacy and legal review.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
